title: PINN-Slicer: Exploiting Rotational Symmetry to Solve the Photon Orbit Equation Around a Black Hole
abstract: arXiv:2611.33953v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) typically struggle with long-horizon domains, often requiring the network to be retrained as the domain grows. We present PINN-Slicer, a method for second-order autonomous ordinary differential equations, $\ddot{u} = G(u, \dot{u})$, which exploits the invariance of this class of equations under translations of the independent variable. A single PINN, embedded within a solution ansatz that enforces the initial conditions explicitly, is trained on a thin slice of the independent variable using Sobol-sampled initial conditions. The PINN is then deployed recursively, slice-by-slice, across the full domain. translated_title: PINN-Slicer：利用旋转对称性求解黑洞周围的光子轨道方程
translated_abstract: 物理信息神经网络（PINNs）通常在长时域问题上表现不佳，往往需要随着求解域的增长对网络进行重新训练。我们提出了PINN-Slicer，这是一种针对二阶自治常微分方程 $\ddot{u} = G(u, \dot{u})$ 的方法，它利用了这类方程在自变量平移下的不变性。单个PINN被嵌入到一个显式强制初始条件的解拟设中，使用Sobol采样的初始条件在自变量的一个薄切片上进行训练。随后，该PINN被递归地、逐片地部署到整个求解域上。我们在描述黑洞周围光子轨道的非线性方程上对PINN-Slicer进行了演示，相对于有限差分参考解，在 $u = r_s/r$（以史瓦西半径为单位的无量纲逆径向坐标）上达到了逐点均方根误差（RMSE）低于 $10^{-3}$ 的精度。
tldr: 提出PINN-Slicer方法，利用二阶自治常微分方程在自变量平移下的不变性，将单个PINN逐片递归地部署到整个求解域，成功求解黑洞周围光子轨道方程，RMSE低于10^-3。
en_tdlr: PINN-Slicer exploits the invariance of second-order autonomous ODEs under translations of the independent variable to recursively deploy a single PINN slice-by-slice across the full domain, solving the black hole photon orbit equation with RMSE below 10^-3.
